posts.title: Step 0 - Goals and foundations
posts.description: Description Making a conlang can be very exciting so I bet you're aching to get your pen to paper, but first it's important to make a solid base to work from. A lot of the time beginners get lost or confused because they don't know exactly what it is they're trying to accomplish with their languages and that leads to a lack of direction and sometimes end results that aren't very coherent.
